name: 44632 · Hartville, OH
findings: ZIP 44632 (Hartville) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44632 (Hartville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
